item.title: On a enfin roulé avec le Range Rover Sport Electric : il ne fait plus de bruit, mais c’est toujours un vrai Range
item.description: Quelques jours après son grand frère, le Range Rover Sport passe lui aussi à l'électrique avec une immense batterie et deux moteurs. Fidèle à son positionnement luxueux, le SUV britannique privilégie la puissance, le statut et les performances tout-terrain à l'efficience pure. On a déjà pu faire quelques tours de roues à bord du SUV électrique.

item.title: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
item.description: The US executive branch is no longer acknowledging the existence of "artificial intelligence." Going forward, official policy websites, policy documents, and press releases will refer only to "Super Intelligence," thanks to a new executive order signed by President Donald Trump. "The word super is the best word of all, and it's the simplest," Trump said […]...

item.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
item.description: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

item.title: Your car and its mobile app are probably handing over all kinds of data to tech companies
item.description: Researchers at Northeastern University found vehicles and their companion apps regularly shared detailed data with some of the largest tech companies.
